title: 第166章 拿小命来玩第165章 木秀于林
content_zh:
沿着祠堂的边缘行走，图纸上标注的坐标已经越来越接近了，白月感觉到方位感正在收拢。
沿着长满青苔的石板路再深入，白月摸到了祠堂后方，穿过一道小拱门，面前便出现了一棵老槐树。
这棵树的树干很粗，至少得需要两个人合抱才抱住，树冠遮住了大半片天空，枝叶浓密得连阳光都透不进来。
白月停下来，低头看着图纸上标注的坐标，又抬头看了看周围的环境。
“到了？”布朗看到白月停下了脚步。
“嗯。”白月点点头，但生起了一丝疑惑。
坐标指向的位置就在这里，但这附近没有明显的建筑，周围也没有人，那么义老让她来这里，是想要做什么？
就在白月思考的时候，一旁的布朗正拿着一根不知道从哪里捡来的粗树枝，一直在石板上乱敲。
“布朗叔，你在干什么？”
布朗的异常行为成功打断了白月的思绪，她一脸疑惑地看着他。
“如果这里就是目的地的话，那可能就是那条密道。”布朗没有抬头，手上的动作一直不停，一边敲一边说：“从前小姐带过我过这里几次，她知道这里有一条密道，就藏在一块青石板下方，每次她进去都都让我把石板盖上，在外面望风，然后过好一会出来后又原封不动地把石板盖回上去。”
他敲了敲旁边的一块石板，发出沉闷的响声。“不过每次我们都是晚上去的，而且过很久了，我也不记得是哪块石板了，我刚刚就想着拿棍子敲一敲，如果下面是密道的话，敲出来肯定有空鼓的。”
白月愣了一下，布朗的方法虽然粗糙，但确实有效，如果石板下面是空的，敲上去的声音和实心地面肯定不一样。
她学着布朗的样子，拿起一根树枝，敲了敲脚下的石板，声音沉闷而扎实，是实心的。
白月又敲了几块石板，声音都是沉的，她扫视了一下周围，好家伙，这里石板都上百块，长得都差不多，他们两个人就这么一块一块敲过去，得找到什么时候？
她站起身，没有再敲。而是闭上眼，把注意力集中到脚下那片区域，她好像很久没有这样调动过眼睛透视的这个能力了。
当她再次睁开眼的时候，一块块石板的结构在她视线里层层剥开，她很快便看到了那个入口，就在距离她左侧1米远的一块石板下面，它的底下是空的，白月能在漆黑中看到下面有台阶。
那块石板表面看着和其他石板没有区别，不过眼尖的白月还是注意到上面有一个很小的图案，那个图案跟家中花瓶上的一模一样。
“找到了。”
白月走了过去，用手拨开那块石板表面的浮土，试着用手指扣住石板的边缘，往上提了一下，没想到石板比想象中的轻很多，一下整个就被掀开了，露出一个黑漆漆的洞口。

布朗也把手上的木枝丢到一边，连忙跑了过来。
两人都探头往那个洞内看去，可惜里面实在太黑，只能透过外层阳光看到里面有一层楼梯往下蔓延。
白月没有犹豫，打开手机灯光就钻了进去，临走时布朗对着洞口内的白月说道：“小小姐，我就不下去了。我在这里等您。”
白月朝洞口应了声好，也没听到布朗是否有回应，因为她已经摸黑沿着石阶往下走了。
阶梯的沙砾感很强，鞋子踩上去都会有沙沙的声音，在这幽暗的环境下，显得格外响亮。
content_en:
Walking along the edge of the ancestral hall, the coordinates marked on the drawing were getting closer and closer, and Bai Yue felt that her sense of direction was shrinking.
Going deeper along the moss-covered stone road, Bai Yue touched the back of the ancestral hall, passed through a small arch, and saw an old locust tree in front of her.
The trunk of this tree is so thick that it requires at least two people to hug it. The crown of the tree covers most of the sky, and the branches and leaves are so thick that even sunlight cannot penetrate.
Bai Yue stopped, looked down at the coordinates marked on the drawing, and then looked up at the surrounding environment.
"Are you here?" Brown stopped when he saw Bai Yue.
"Yeah." Bai Yue nodded, but a little doubt arose.
The coordinates point to the location here, but there are no obvious buildings nearby and there are no people around. So what does Yi Lao want to do by asking her to come here?
While Bai Yue was thinking, Brown on the side was holding a thick branch he picked up from nowhere and kept banging on the stone slab.
"Uncle Brown, what are you doing?"
Brown's unusual behavior successfully interrupted Bai Yue's thoughts, and she looked at him with confusion.
"If this is the destination, then it may be the secret passage." Brown did not raise his head, and kept moving his hands as he knocked: "My lady took me here several times before. She knew that there was a secret passage here, hidden under a bluestone slab. Every time she went in, she asked me to cover the stone slab and watch the wind outside. Then after a while, she came out and put the stone slab back intact."
He knocked on a stone slab next to him, making a dull sound. "But every time we go there at night, and it's been a long time, I don't remember which stone slab it is. I just thought about knocking it with a stick. If there is a secret passage below, there will definitely be holes when I knock it out."
Bai Yue was stunned for a moment. Although Brown's method was rough, it was indeed effective. If the stone slab was empty, the sound of knocking it up would definitely be different from the solid ground.
She followed Brown's example, picked up a branch, and knocked on the stone slab under her feet. The sound was dull and solid, and it was solid.
Bai Yue knocked on a few more slates, the sound was deep. She glanced around, good guys, there are hundreds of slates here, and they are all similar in size. The two of them just knocked on them one by one. When will they find it?
She stood up and didn't knock again. Instead, she closed her eyes and focused her attention on the area under her feet. It seemed that she hadn't used the ability of her eyes to see through this for a long time.
When she opened her eyes again, the structure of the stone slabs peeled off layer by layer in her sight. She soon saw the entrance, which was under a stone slab 1 meter away from her left. It was empty at the bottom. Bai Yue could see steps below in the darkness.
The slate looked no different from other slates on the surface, but the sharp-eyed Bai Yue still noticed a small pattern on it, which was exactly the same as the one on the vase at home.
"Found it."
Bai Yue walked over, pushed away the loose soil on the surface of the stone slab with her hands, tried to hold the edge of the stone slab with her fingers, and lifted it up. Unexpectedly, the stone slab was much lighter than expected, and the entire stone slab was lifted open, revealing a dark hole.
Brown also threw aside the wooden branch in his hand and ran over quickly.
Both of them looked into the hole, but unfortunately it was too dark inside, and they could only see a staircase going down through the outer layer of sunlight.
Bai Yue did not hesitate, turned on the light of her mobile phone and got in. Before leaving, Brown said to Bai Yue at the entrance of the cave: "Little miss, I won't go down. I'll wait for you here."
Bai Yue said hello to the entrance of the cave, but she didn't hear Brown's response because she had already walked down the stone steps in the dark.
The stairs have a strong sense of gravel, and there is a rustling sound when you step on your shoes, which is particularly loud in this dark environment.
